Section 2 Where are we? We are based in the School of Biosciences, a component of the Faculty of Sciences. The school is a large complex of buildings at the heart of the University and hosts five research clusters: Molecular Microbiology: Biochemistry to Disease (MMBD) (where we are based) Ecology and Evolutionary Biology (EEB) (Good source of collaborations) Development, Regeneration and Neurophysiology (DRN) Molecular and Cellular Biology (MCB) Plants, Photosynthesis and Soil (PPS) We are based in the oldest part of the University, Firth Court (FC). Other buildings that make up the complex are the Florey, Perak, Addison, Edwardian and Alfred Denny (AD) buildings. Of these, the AD building most important to know about as it contains the lecture theatres where Biosciences seminars are held - you can access these by exiting FC from the front, taking the stairs down on your left and reentering the complex through the entrance immediately on your left. Needless to say there are many other routes but these will be left as an opportunity for exploration of the Biosciences rat nest! knitr::include_graphics(“https://github.com/Pseudomoaner/PoME_handbook/blob/main/Images/BiosciencesMap.png”) Some room numbers in the complex which may be of use: F21: Our lab space (shared with Laia Pasquina-Lemonche) F18: The lab space of Simon Foster - contains lots of communal equipment in frequent use by the group G05: Oli’s office

Section 3 What’s on the schedule? 3.1 Group meetings 3.1.1 Joint group meetings 3.1.2 PoME meetings We hold meetings within PoME every two weeks. 3.2 Seminar series knitr::include_graphics(“https://github.com/Pseudomoaner/PoME_handbook/blob/main/Images/BiosciencesMap.png”) 3.3 Cluster meetings MMBD holds cluster-wide meetings at 4pm on the first Friday of every month. These are predominantly meant for PIs in the cluster, but other cluster members are welcome to join. As well as administrative matters, these meetings are an opportunity for cluster members to pitch new grant or paper ideas to a reasonably generous audience. If you are interested in putting together a fellowship application (see chapter X) this is a good forum to get feedback on your idea at an early stage of development. 3.4 Social stuff EEB holds coffee and news mornings every Tuesday at 10:30-11:00 am. MMBD PIs typically migrate to the university pub (the Uni Arms) after cluster meetings on Fridays, while EEB members tend to start gathering there at about 5pm every week.
